explication: This repository is a Go client library wrapping Telegram’s Bot API, not a bot framework: applications construct typed requests, fetch updates by polling or webhook, and send API responses. The central transport and request dispatch live in bot.go; configs.go encodes endpoint-specific requests, helpers.go supplies constructors, and types.go plus passport.go define API payloads. The README documents broad API coverage and both polling and webhook workflows. Unsampled portions prevent mapping individual endpoint families or asserting additional internal call relationships.
